latestVersion.changelog: Add native Brave API Search plugin successor link; preserve existing skill tools.

raw_record.summary: Real-time web search, autosuggest, and AI-powered answers using the official Brave Search API. Use for searching documentation, facts, current events, or any web content. Supports AI grounded answers with citations and query autosuggest. Requires BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY and BRAVE_ANSWERS_API_KEY.
